ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as process values(Processes.process_path) as process_path values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent_process_name from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("AnyDesk.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe","ConnectWiseControl.exe","SplashtopStreamer.exe","SRService.exe","FleetDeckAgent.exe","PulsewayService.exe","TeamViewer.exe","TeamViewer_Service.exe","AteraAgent.exe","Action1_agent.exe","RustDesk.exe","MeshAgent.exe","SimpleHelpCustomer.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","Domotz.exe") OR Processes.process IN ("*anydesk*","*screenconnect*","*splashtop*","*fleetdeck*","*pulseway*","*rustdesk*","*ateraagent*","*action1*","*meshagent*","*simplehelp*")) AND (Processes.process_path IN ("*\\Downloads\\*","*\\Temp\\*","*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*","*\\Public\\*","*\\ProgramData\\*") OR Processes.parent_process_name IN ("msiexec.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","curl.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where user!="*$" | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let RmmBins = dynamic(["anydesk.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","connectwisecontrol.exe","splashtopstreamer.exe","srservice.exe","fleetdeckagent.exe","pulsewayservice.exe","teamviewer.exe","teamviewer_service.exe","ateraagent.exe","action1_agent.exe","rustdesk.exe","meshagent.exe","simplehelpcustomer.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","domotz.exe"]);
let RmmTokens = dynamic(["anydesk","screenconnect","connectwise","splashtop","fleetdeck","pulseway","rustdesk","ateraagent","action1","meshagent","simplehelp","tacticalrmm"]);
let SuspiciousParents = dynamic(["msiexec.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","curl.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe"]);
let UserWritable = dynamic([@"\Downloads\", @"\Temp\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Public\", @"\ProgramData\"]);
let BaselineDays = 30d;
let Baseline = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp between (ago(BaselineDays) .. ago(1d))
    | where tolower(FileName) in (RmmBins)
    | summarize by DeviceName, FileName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
| where tolower(FileName) in (RmmBins) or ProcessCommandLine has_any (RmmTokens)
| where (FolderPath has_any (UserWritable) or InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (UserWritable))
   or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (SuspiciousParents)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| join kind=leftanti Baseline on DeviceName, FileName   // first-seen on this host
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc

title: Scattered Spider RMM Tool Drop From User-Writable Path
id: 9d2c7f10-7e3c-4a9b-9c3e-2b8a1e7f6c44
status: experimental
description: Detects Scattered Spider's signature commodity RMM agents being executed from Downloads/Temp/Public/ProgramData or spawned by msiexec/powershell/curl, used as the first hands-on persistence layer after help-desk MFA reset.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-320a
  - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2023/10/25/octo-tempest-crosses-boundaries-to-facilitate-extortion-encryption-and-destruction/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1219.002
  - attack.t1105
  - g1015
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  rmm_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\AnyDesk.exe'
      - '\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe'
      - '\ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe'
      - '\ConnectWiseControl.exe'
      - '\SplashtopStreamer.exe'
      - '\FleetDeckAgent.exe'
      - '\PulsewayService.exe'
      - '\TeamViewer.exe'
      - '\AteraAgent.exe'
      - '\Action1_agent.exe'
      - '\RustDesk.exe'
      - '\MeshAgent.exe'
      - '\SimpleHelpCustomer.exe'
      - '\tacticalrmm.exe'
  user_path:
    Image|contains:
      - '\Downloads\'
      - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
      - '\Public\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
  suspect_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\msiexec.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
  condition: rmm_image and (user_path or suspect_parent)
falsepositives:
  - Sanctioned IT-managed RMM rollouts (allow-list installer hashes / signing certs and authorized deployment hosts)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\AnyDesk.exe OR *\anydesk.exe OR *\ANYDESK.EXE OR *\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe OR *\screenconnect.clientservice.exe OR *\SplashtopStreamer.exe OR *\splashtopstreamer.exe OR *\FleetDeckAgent.exe OR *\fleetdeckagent.exe OR *\PulsewayService.exe OR *\pulsewayservice.exe OR *\RustDesk.exe OR *\rustdesk.exe OR *\AteraAgent.exe OR *\ateraagent.exe OR *\Action1_agent.exe OR *\action1_agent.exe OR *\MeshAgent.exe OR *\meshagent.exe OR *\SimpleHelpCustomer.exe OR *\simplehelpcustomer.exe) AND (@Image:(*\Downloads\* OR *\downloads\* OR *\AppData\Local\Temp\* OR *\appdata\local\temp\* OR *\Public\* OR *\public\* OR *\ProgramData\* OR *\programdata\*) OR @ParentImage:(*\msiexec.exe OR *\MSIEXEC.EXE OR *\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\cmd.exe OR *\CMD.EXE OR *\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE OR *\curl.exe OR *\CURL.EXE OR *\certutil.exe OR *\CertUtil.exe OR *\bitsadmin.exe OR *\BITSADMIN.EXE))

ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider help-desk takeover — new MFA method registered then privileged role / app credential added within 24h
ucs.description: Hunts the actor's signature Entra ID intrusion chain: vishing the help desk to register a new authentication method (FIDO key, Authenticator phone, or SMS) on a high-value account, then within 24h using that fresh session to mint a long-lived foothold — assigning a privileged directory role, adding a service-principal/app credential, or creating a new federated domain (Golden SAML). Microsoft (Octo Tempest), Mandiant (UNC3944) and CISA AA23-320A all flag this as the consistent identity-takeover pattern across MGM, Caesars, Clorox, Twilio (0ktapus) and the 2024 retail/insurance campaigns.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as mfa_add_time values(All_Changes.user) as target_user values(All_Changes.src) as registration_ip from datamodel=Change where All_Changes.action IN ("User registered security info","Update user","Admin registered security info","Register security info") All_Changes.object_category="User" by All_Changes.user All_Changes.object | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Changes)` | rename user as target_user | join type=inner target_user [ | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as priv_time values(All_Changes.action) as priv_action values(All_Changes.src) as priv_src from datamodel=Change where All_Changes.action IN ("Add member to role","Add app role assignment to service principal","Add service principal credentials","Add owner to application","Add owner to service principal","Set federation settings on domain","Set domain authentication","Add partner to company") by All_Changes.user All_Changes.action | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Changes)` | rename user as target_user ] | where priv_time >= mfa_add_time AND priv_time <= mfa_add_time + 86400 | table mfa_add_time priv_time target_user registration_ip priv_action priv_src
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowSec = 86400;
let MfaAdds = CloudAppEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("User registered security info", "Admin registered security info", "Update user", "Register security info")
    | extend Target = tostring(parse_json(tostring(ActivityObjects))[0].Name)
    | project MfaTime = Timestamp, Target = tolower(coalesce(Target, AccountDisplayName)), MfaActor = AccountDisplayName, MfaIP = IPAddress, MfaUA = UserAgent;
let PrivChanges = CloudAppEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in (
        "Add member to role",
        "Add app role assignment to service principal",
        "Add service principal credentials",
        "Update application Certificates and secrets management",
        "Add owner to application",
        "Add owner to service principal",
        "Set federation settings on domain",
        "Set domain authentication",
        "Add partner to company")
    | extend Target = tostring(parse_json(tostring(ActivityObjects))[0].Name)
    | project PrivTime = Timestamp, Target = tolower(coalesce(Target, AccountDisplayName)), PrivAction = ActionType, PrivActor = AccountDisplayName, PrivIP = IPAddress, PrivUA = UserAgent, PrivRaw = RawEventData;
MfaAdds
| join kind=inner PrivChanges on Target
| where PrivTime between (MfaTime .. MfaTime + WindowSec * 1s)
| extend DeltaMin = datetime_diff('minute', PrivTime, MfaTime)
| project MfaTime, PrivTime, DeltaMin, Target, MfaActor, MfaIP, MfaUA, PrivAction, PrivActor, PrivIP, PrivUA
| order by MfaTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowSec = 86400;
let MfaAdds = AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where OperationName in ("User registered security info", "Admin registered security info", "Update user", "Register security info", "User started security info registration")
    | extend Target = tolower(tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName))
    | extend MfaActor = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
    | extend MfaIP = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
    | project MfaTime = TimeGenerated, Target, MfaActor, MfaIP, OperationName;
let PrivChanges = AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where OperationName in (
        "Add member to role",
        "Add eligible member to role",
        "Add app role assignment to service principal",
        "Add service principal credentials",
        "Update application - Certificates and secrets management",
        "Add owner to application",
        "Add owner to service principal",
        "Set federation settings on domain",
        "Set domain authentication",
        "Add partner to company")
    | extend Target = tolower(tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName))
    | extend PrivActor = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
    | extend PrivIP = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
    | project PrivTime = TimeGenerated, Target, PrivActor, PrivIP, PrivAction = OperationName, TargetResources;
MfaAdds
| join kind=inner PrivChanges on Target
| where PrivTime between (MfaTime .. MfaTime + WindowSec * 1s)
| extend DeltaMin = datetime_diff('minute', PrivTime, MfaTime)
| project MfaTime, PrivTime, DeltaMin, Target, MfaActor, MfaIP, OperationName, PrivActor, PrivIP, PrivAction
| order by MfaTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:azure.activeDirectory @evt.name:("User registered security info" OR "Admin registered security info" OR "Add member to role" OR "Add service principal credentials" OR "Update application - Certificates and secrets management" OR "Set federation settings on domain" OR "Add partner to company")
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=IdpAuthenticationLog
| OperationName=/^(User registered security info|Admin registered security info|Add member to role|Add app role assignment to service principal|Add service principal credentials|Update application - Certificates and secrets management|Add owner to application|Set federation settings on domain|Set domain authentication|Add partner to company)$/i
| groupBy([TargetUserPrincipalName], function=[count(field=OperationName, distinct=true, as=DistinctOps), collect([OperationName, InitiatedBy, IPAddress, @timestamp])])
| DistinctOps >= 2
